plan: One sand beach screen with 26 capital letters traced from a glowing start pebble, voiced letter sounds and a sand picture reward per letter. Lowercase partners and name tracing are left for later.
Ten levels for numerals 1 to 10: trace the sand numeral, then tap each waddling chick once while the Orbi counts aloud. Turtle and fawn variants and the Beadle line are deferred.
A single pool screen where three leaf boats carry pictures and the Orbi voices a first sound; 60 picture words over 12 sounds with a stone harbor reward. Four-boat rounds and close sounds come later.
Sandbar screen where Soru shows a picture and the child drags its rhyme from three choices to Tari; 20 rhyme pairs, all voiced. Rhyme chains and the sing-along mode are left out.

Dusk beach where Rela shows one side of an opposite and the child taps the other from three picture pebbles; 20 opposite pairs with voiced names. Drag acting and the light and dark night round are deferred.
Twenty stepping stone levels covering AB, ABB, AAB and ABC color and shape patterns; drag the missing stone and Linky hops across. Sound stones and the build-your-own path come later.
Tree screen with four nests: 20 levels moving from color only to shape only to color and shape together, 40 items to sort. Size as a third rule and the secret rule game are left out.
Sixteen wide finger mazes over three riverbank scenes; the chick follows the finger home and turns back with a giggle and voiced hint at dead ends. Drawing paths for friends is deferred.
Fifteen chunky puzzles of 6, 9 and 12 pieces with a fading ghost outline, each picture animating when finished. The gallery nest and mixed-picture mode are left for later.
Beach memory game with 6, 8 and 12 pebbles hiding ten animal friends with their own sounds, ending with the Orbi tidying every pebble back. The sound-only round is deferred.
Twenty twin nest pictures over eight nest scenes with one to three big differences and a wiggle hint after a pause. Seasonal nests and making a change for a friend are left out.
Twelve dot-to-dot animals of 3 to 10 glowing pebbles tapped in order with voiced counting; each animal comes alive. No printed numerals; the night parade and count-back round come later.
After-rain screen with three primary puddles; tap two and the Orbi mixes them into orange, green or purple, plus eight friend wishes to match. Painting the whole beach is deferred.
Mirror pond scenes for four feelings: tap the face pebble that matches a friend, then pick a kind action, 24 little scenes, all voiced. Two-friend scenes and proud or surprised come later.
Twelve three- and four-stone stories, starting with a nest day routine and then seeds, eggs and rain; the right order plays a short voiced cartoon. The silly free-order story mode is left out.

One picnic cloth screen where the child drags copied fruit, bowls and cups to three to six friends, one each, with munch and thank-you reactions. New picnic places and the cooking corner are deferred.
Nest clinic with four plush patients and five gentle problems, each solved by asking first, scanning and dragging the right soft tool. Two-problem patients and the plush maker are left out.

Sharing circle with five friends showing thought bubbles; the child drags a matching gift and gets one back, with share, swap and turn-taking rounds. No coins, prices or stalls; borrowing comes later.
Twenty-four arrow stone puzzles on 2x2 to 3x3 sand grids; the Orbi rolls the path and giggles back on a wrong step. Loop stones, obstacles and 4x4 grids are deferred.
Six panorama scenes where the Orbi asks for circles, squares, triangles or rectangles and the child taps them, 12 rounds. The build-a-friend collecting mode is left for later.
Twenty comparison rounds: tap the longer stick or watch the leaf balance tip under the heavier thing, then order three. Measuring in pebbles and full or empty cups come later.
One riverbank tree shown in four seasons; drag matching weather, animals and clothes into the picture over eight rounds. The season wheel and daily weather dress choices are deferred.
